body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. Move up to 2 units afterward, even on a miss; hit targets cannot make movement Reactions against this movement.

surges.html: You may pass through the hit target's space, without stopping there.
On a hit, the target is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Contingency - Evasion
rider.html: When the target next closes to within 1 unit of you, you may move 1 unit away without triggering its movement Reactions.
